rows.label: bf06350100_0020
rows.name:
Precisely. In Iira, our family
were just a cadet branch.

rows.label: bf06350100_0030
rows.name:
We merely took advantage of the postwar chaos
to gain our current position.

rows.label: bf06350100_0040
rows.name:
But then... we're just
a bunch of usurpers!

rows.label: bf06350100_0060
rows.name:
Even if it meant going that far,
we had to keep the nation alive...

rows.label: bf06350100_0070
rows.name: Even if it means using Adel's name?

rows.label: bf06350100_0080
rows.name: After Iira lost its lord, much blood was spilled.

rows.label: bf06350100_0090
rows.name: It was necessary to unite it as Luxuria.
